name: v1.56.0
body:
### Added Features

- tighten source-distribution external refs [PR [#5493](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5493) @wagoodman]
- output source PURL as external reference [PR [#5246](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5246) @swadaptive]
- Full cataloging of archive contents [Issue [#246](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/246)] [PR [#5260](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5260) @kzantow]

### Bug Fixes

- hash each file once in the file digest cataloger [PR [#5491](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5491) @wagoodman]
- Support envoy binary various versions [Issue [#5470](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5470)] [PR [#5476](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5476) @pujitha24]
- Support istio binary various versions [Issue [#5060](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5060)] [PR [#5121](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5121) @hsdfat]
- CPE identifiers contain a wildcard in the CPE part field for packages discovered by the Bitnami cataloger [Issue [#5123](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5123)] [PR [#5127](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5127) @vigneshakaviki]

### Additional Changes

- Gradle lockfile comment line is catalogued as a package [Issue [#5371](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5371)] [PR [#5372](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5372) @pujitha24]
- use correct error variable in package load [PR [#4983](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/4983) @idhyt]
- let go-make own the go version [PR [#5464](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5464) @wagoodman]
- preserve semver build metadata in ffmpeg version [PR [#5452](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5452) @akshaver]

### Dependencies

40 dependency changes (38 updated, 1 added, 1 removed). 1 vulnerability remediated.

**🟢 Remediated (1)**

- [GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q) (High) — github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4
